subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: What default-off privacy and exposure contract should inbound WhatsApp call events use before agents or plugins can see them?
rationale: The missing listener is source-proven, but default behavior, metadata retention, access-control filtering, and agent/plugin visibility are product and security-boundary choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Default-off sanitized listener
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that emits only filtered call activity metadata after existing account, DM/group, allowlist, and self-chat checks.

options.title: Plugin hook only first
options.body: Expose call events only through a documented plugin hook and defer agent session/tool behavior until a later product decision.

options.title: Defer inbound call events
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide the privacy and live-verification cost is worth adding this capability.

recommendation.title: Default-off sanitized listener
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that emits only filtered call activity metadata after existing account, DM/group, allowlist, and self-chat checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently owned related WhatsApp call work and already scoped the privacy and access-control boundaries in the issue discussion.
